#!/usr/bin/python3
import os,time
home=os.environ['HOME']
os.chmod('target',0o222)
open(home+'/ready','w').close()
for _ in range(1500):
 if os.path.exists(home+'/release'):break
 time.sleep(.01)
os.chmod('target',0o644)
open(home+'/restored','w').close()

#!/usr/bin/python3
import os,time,glob,re,stat
h=os.environ['HOME']
try:
 for _ in range(1500):
  if os.path.exists(h+'/collect'):break
  time.sleep(.01)
 else:raise RuntimeError('missing collection acknowledgment')
 backups=glob.glob(h+'/f.txt~*')
 assert len(backups)==1,backups
 p=backups[0]
 assert re.fullmatch(r'f[.]txt~[A-Za-z0-9]{6}',os.path.basename(p))
 assert stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(p).st_mode)==0o666
 assert open(p,'rb').read()==b'hello\n'
 os.rename(p,h+'/retained-backup')
 open(h+'/collected','w').close()
finally:
 os.chmod('dir',0o755)
